name: ENGENT
old_description: Engent is a provider of next generation electronic manufacturing and technology services. Engent leverages its world-class facilities, highly experienced and educated team to provide solutions to a sophisticated client base which shorten a product’s time to market and which enable products to be manufactured at high volumes.
about:
Engent is based in Norcross, Georgia. The company was founded by Matt Perry, who serves as Managing Director and Founder; no founding year is disclosed. The business began as a provider of electronic manufacturing and technology services.

Engent delivers advanced electronic research, manufacturing, and development services. Its capabilities span advanced assembly, electronics production, design support, and a suite of analytical, reliability, and failure testing. The company operates from what it describes as world‑class facilities, targeting high‑volume production while also supporting early‑stage development.

Engent serves the technology and electronics sectors, with a client base that includes major manufacturers such as Siemens Dematic, Solectron, Flextronics, and the U.S. Navy’s NAVSEA command. Its services are tailored for sophisticated customers requiring rapid time‑to‑market and robust, reliable products.

The company emphasizes its ability to shorten product development cycles and enable high‑volume manufacturing through a broad service portfolio that extends beyond assembly. Engent states that its integrated approach—combining design support, advanced assembly, and rigorous testing—ensures the most robust, reliable products on the market.
